description: Tool to mark an invitee as a no-show for a scheduled event. Use when an invitee fails to attend their scheduled meeting and you need to record their absence in Calendly.

inputSchema.description: Request model for marking an invitee as a no-show.

invitee.description: URI of the Invitee to be marked as a no-show. This must be a valid URI referencing an existing invitee from a scheduled event (e.g., 'https://api.calendly.com/scheduled_events/GBGBDCAADAEDCRZ2/invitees/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA').
invitee.title: Invitee

inputSchema.title: InviteeNoShowRequest

name: invitee_no_show

InviteeNoShowResource.description: The invitee no-show resource containing details of the no-show record.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the no show record was created
created_at.title: Created At

invitee.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the associated Invitee who was marked as a no-show
invitee.title: Invitee

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the no show record
uri.title: Uri

InviteeNoShowResource.title: InviteeNoShowResource

InviteeNoShowResponse.description: Response model containing the created no-show record details.

resource.description: The main container object for the invitee no-show record
resource.title: Resource
